from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter, map_coordinates
import artifact_io

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
H,W=144,256

def poly_mask(points,scale=6):
    im=Image.new('L',(W*scale,H*scale),0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(im).polygon([(round(x*scale),round(y*scale)) for x,y in points],fill=255)
    return np.array(im.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS),dtype=float)/255

def smooth(t):
    t=np.clip(t,0,1)
    return t*t*(3-2*t)

def generate():
    orig=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'),dtype=float)
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[:H,:W]
    # Recover the small piece of the laboratory backdrop hidden by the jaws.
    bg=orig.copy()
    for y in range(32):
        # The distant surface has an almost linear light gradient on either side
        # of the manipulator; retain its photographic grain in the revealed area.
        left=np.median(orig[y,96:102],axis=0)
        right=np.median(orig[y,133:140],axis=0)
        slope=(right-left)/(136-98.5)
        for x in range(101,133):
            base=left+slope*(x-98.5)
            sample=orig[y,137+(x-101)%10]
            local=gaussian_filter(orig[:32,136:149],sigma=(1.2,1.2,0))[y,(x-101)%10+1]
            bg[y,x]=base+(sample-local)*0.55
    # Projected bevelled block faces, filling only the part occluded by the tool.
    # The long visible faces and the gate are kept photographic and stationary.
    A=(112.0,19.3); B=(119.5,21.5); C=(126.0,16.8); D=(118.7,14.5)
    Af=(110.6,60.8); Bf=(118.5,63.0); Cf=(124.0,58.7)
    front=poly_mask([A,B,Bf,Af])
    side=poly_mask([B,C,Cf,Bf])
    top=poly_mask([A,D,C,B])
    shape=np.maximum.reduce([front,side,top])
    rng=np.random.default_rng(74)
    grain=gaussian_filter(rng.normal(size=(H,W)),.35)
    colors=np.zeros_like(orig)
    weights=front+side+top
    fcol=np.stack([195-.10*(yy-25),113-.05*(yy-25),116-.08*(yy-25)],axis=-1)
    scol=np.stack([204-.28*(yy-21),124-.18*(yy-21),130-.22*(yy-21)],axis=-1)
    tcol=np.zeros_like(orig)+[218,139,154]
    colors=(fcol*front[:,:,None]+scol*side[:,:,None]+tcol*top[:,:,None])/np.maximum(weights[:,:,None],1e-6)
    colors+=grain[:,:,None]*0.75
    procedural=bg*(1-shape[:,:,None])+colors*shape[:,:,None]
    # Replace the upper occluded region. On visible faces, preserve photograph
    # texture, blending smoothly from the synthesized upper bevel to the source.
    final=orig.copy()
    upper=(yy<30)&(xx>=100)&(xx<=132)
    final[upper]=procedural[upper]
    is_pink=(orig[:,:,0]>170)&(orig[:,:,0]-orig[:,:,1]>48)&(orig[:,:,2]>98)
    preserve=shape*is_pink*smooth((yy-25)/5)
    preserve[(yy<27)|(yy>=30)]=0
    final=final*(1-preserve[:,:,None])+orig*preserve[:,:,None]
    # In the unoccluded side, matching source texture avoids any colour jump.
    safe=(xx>=120)&(yy>=18)&(yy<30)&is_pink
    final[safe]=orig[safe]
    # Exact source-based matte for the curved black-backed blue jaw assembly.
    contour=poly_mask([(102.0,-3),(131.0,-3),(130.0,4),(129.0,10),
                       (128.5,14),(127.7,16.7),(126.7,17.8),(125.8,17.0),
                       (125.2,16.2),(121.8,15.6),(118.6,15.7),
                       (118.5,19),(117.8,21.2),(116.9,22.8),(115.7,24),
                       (113.8,25.3),(111.9,25.8),(110.0,25.4),
                       (108.0,24),(106.2,21.5),(105.4,18),(104.2,11),(102.5,3)])
    # Estimate edge coverage from the almost constant red channel of both the
    # dark metal and blue rubber; solve the photographed edge colour exactly.
    alpha=np.clip((final[:,:,0]-orig[:,:,0])/(final[:,:,0]-11+1e-8),0,1)
    interior=(orig[:,:,0]<27)&(contour>.5)
    alpha[interior]=1
    allowed=(contour>.02)&(yy<27)&(xx>100)&(xx<132)
    # Pink reflections and shadows are not solid jaw material.
    alpha[~allowed]=0
    alpha[(orig[:,:,0]>140)&(xx>116)&(yy>15)]=0
    alpha[alpha<.04]=0
    # Independent contact/occlusion shadow on the upper pink surfaces.
    shadow=np.zeros_like(orig)
    unmatte=alpha<.001
    changes=orig-final
    shadow[upper&unmatte]=changes[upper&unmatte]
    base0=final+shadow
    fg=np.zeros_like(orig)
    nz=alpha>.001
    fg[nz]=(orig[nz]-base0[nz]*(1-alpha[nz,None]))/alpha[nz,None]
    fg=np.clip(fg,0,255)
    rgba=fg*alpha[:,:,None]
    # Extend the shaft above the image for the subpixel contact motion.
    pad=40
    pa=np.pad(alpha,((pad,pad),(0,0)),mode='constant')
    pr=np.pad(rgba,((pad,pad),(0,0),(0,0)),mode='constant')
    for k in range(pad):
        pa[k]=alpha[0]
        pr[k]=rgba[0]
    frames=[]
    for i in range(20):
        t=i/4
        if t<.5:
            dy=.65*smooth(t/.5)
        elif t<1.25:
            dy=.65
        else:
            elapsed=t-1.25
            dy=.65-(8.8*elapsed*elapsed if elapsed<1.65 else 23.958+29.04*(elapsed-1.65))
        # Release before lifting, then smoothly remove the nearby jaw shadow.
        sf=1-smooth((t-1.25)/.65)
        frame=final+shadow*sf
        dx=.25*smooth((t-1.4)/.9)
        coords=np.array([yy-dy+pad,xx-dx])
        a=map_coordinates(pa,coords,order=1,mode='constant',cval=0)
        col=np.stack([map_coordinates(pr[:,:,c],coords,order=1,mode='constant',cval=0) for c in range(3)],axis=-1)
        frame=frame*(1-a[:,:,None])+col
        frame=np.rint(np.clip(frame,0,255)).astype(np.uint8)
        if i==0:
            frame=orig.astype(np.uint8)
        frames.append(frame)
    return np.stack(frames)

if __name__=='__main__':
    frames=generate()
    artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)

"""Output-only helpers. No drawing or generation policy is implemented here."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter, map_coordinates
import artifact_io

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
H,W=144,256

def poly_mask(points,scale=6):
    im=Image.new('L',(W*scale,H*scale),0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(im).polygon([(round(x*scale),round(y*scale)) for x,y in points],fill=255)
    return np.array(im.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS),dtype=float)/255

def smooth(t):
    t=np.clip(t,0,1)
    return t*t*(3-2*t)

def generate():
    orig=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'),dtype=float)
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[:H,:W]
    # Recover the small piece of the laboratory backdrop hidden by the jaws.
    bg=orig.copy()
    for y in range(32):
        # The distant surface has an almost linear light gradient on either side
        # of the manipulator; retain its photographic grain in the revealed area.
        left=np.median(orig[y,96:102],axis=0)
        right=np.median(orig[y,133:140],axis=0)
        slope=(right-left)/(136-98.5)
        for x in range(101,133):
            base=left+slope*(x-98.5)
            sample=orig[y,137+(x-101)%10]
            local=gaussian_filter(orig[:32,136:149],sigma=(1.2,1.2,0))[y,(x-101)%10+1]
            bg[y,x]=base+(sample-local)*0.55
    # Projected bevelled block faces, filling only the part occluded by the tool.
    # The long visible faces and the gate are kept photographic and stationary.
    A=(112.0,19.3); B=(119.5,21.5); C=(126.0,16.8); D=(118.7,14.5)
    Af=(110.6,60.8); Bf=(118.5,63.0); Cf=(124.0,58.7)
    front=poly_mask([A,B,Bf,Af])
    side=poly_mask([B,C,Cf,Bf])
    top=poly_mask([A,D,C,B])
    shape=np.maximum.reduce([front,side,top])
    rng=np.random.default_rng(74)
    grain=gaussian_filter(rng.normal(size=(H,W)),.35)
    colors=np.zeros_like(orig)
    weights=front+side+top
    fcol=np.stack([195-.10*(yy-25),113-.05*(yy-25),116-.08*(yy-25)],axis=-1)
    scol=np.stack([204-.28*(yy-21),124-.18*(yy-21),130-.22*(yy-21)],axis=-1)
    tcol=np.zeros_like(orig)+[218,139,154]
    colors=(fcol*front[:,:,None]+scol*side[:,:,None]+tcol*top[:,:,None])/np.maximum(weights[:,:,None],1e-6)
    colors+=grain[:,:,None]*0.75
    procedural=bg*(1-shape[:,:,None])+colors*shape[:,:,None]
    # Replace the upper occluded region. On visible faces, preserve photograph
    # texture, blending smoothly from the synthesized upper bevel to the source.
    final=orig.copy()
    upper=(yy<30)&(xx>=100)&(xx<=132)
    final[upper]=procedural[upper]
    is_pink=(orig[:,:,0]>170)&(orig[:,:,0]-orig[:,:,1]>48)&(orig[:,:,2]>98)
    preserve=shape*is_pink*smooth((yy-25)/5)
    preserve[(yy<27)|(yy>=30)]=0
    final=final*(1-preserve[:,:,None])+orig*preserve[:,:,None]
    # In the unoccluded side, matching source texture avoids any colour jump.
    safe=(xx>=120)&(yy>=18)&(yy<30)&is_pink
    final[safe]=orig[safe]
    # Exact source-based matte for the curved black-backed blue jaw assembly.
    contour=poly_mask([(102.0,-3),(131.0,-3),(130.0,4),(129.0,10),
                       (128.5,14),(127.7,16.7),(126.7,17.8),(125.8,17.0),
                       (125.2,16.2),(121.8,15.6),(118.6,15.7),
                       (118.5,19),(117.8,21.2),(116.9,22.8),(115.7,24),
                       (113.8,25.3),(111.9,25.8),(110.0,25.4),
                       (108.0,24),(106.2,21.5),(105.4,18),(104.2,11),(102.5,3)])
    # Estimate edge coverage from the almost constant red channel of both the
    # dark metal and blue rubber; solve the photographed edge colour exactly.
    alpha=np.clip((final[:,:,0]-orig[:,:,0])/(final[:,:,0]-11+1e-8),0,1)
    interior=(orig[:,:,0]<27)&(contour>.5)
    alpha[interior]=1
    allowed=(contour>.02)&(yy<27)&(xx>100)&(xx<132)
    # Pink reflections and shadows are not solid jaw material.
    alpha[~allowed]=0
    alpha[(orig[:,:,0]>140)&(xx>116)&(yy>15)]=0
    alpha[alpha<.04]=0
    # Independent contact/occlusion shadow on the upper pink surfaces.
    shadow=np.zeros_like(orig)
    unmatte=alpha<.001
    changes=orig-final
    shadow[upper&unmatte]=changes[upper&unmatte]
    base0=final+shadow
    fg=np.zeros_like(orig)
    nz=alpha>.001
    fg[nz]=(orig[nz]-base0[nz]*(1-alpha[nz,None]))/alpha[nz,None]
    fg=np.clip(fg,0,255)
    rgba=fg*alpha[:,:,None]
    # Extend the shaft above the image for the subpixel contact motion.
    pad=40
    pa=np.pad(alpha,((pad,pad),(0,0)),mode='constant')
    pr=np.pad(rgba,((pad,pad),(0,0),(0,0)),mode='constant')
    for k in range(pad):
        pa[k]=alpha[0]
        pr[k]=rgba[0]
    frames=[]
    for i in range(20):
        t=i/4
        if t<.5:
            dy=.65*smooth(t/.5)
        elif t<1.25:
            dy=.65
        else:
            elapsed=t-1.25
            dy=.65-(8.8*elapsed*elapsed if elapsed<1.65 else 23.958+29.04*(elapsed-1.65))
        # Release before lifting, then smoothly remove the nearby jaw shadow.
        sf=1-smooth((t-1.25)/.65)
        frame=final+shadow*sf
        dx=.25*smooth((t-1.4)/.9)
        coords=np.array([yy-dy+pad,xx-dx])
        a=map_coordinates(pa,coords,order=1,mode='constant',cval=0)
        col=np.stack([map_coordinates(pr[:,:,c],coords,order=1,mode='constant',cval=0) for c in range(3)],axis=-1)
        frame=frame*(1-a[:,:,None])+col
        frame=np.rint(np.clip(frame,0,255)).astype(np.uint8)
        if i==0:
            frame=orig.astype(np.uint8)
        frames.append(frame)
    return np.stack(frames)

if __name__=='__main__':
    frames=generate()
    artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
